description: This file defines a LangchainProcessor class that integrates Langchain runnables with Pipecat's frame pipeline, handling LLM message frames, invoking Langchain chains, and streaming responses.

classes.name: LangchainProcessor
classes.description: Processor that integrates Langchain runnables with Pipecat's frame pipeline, handling message extraction, invocation, and streaming responses.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LangchainProcessor with a chain and optional transcript key.

methods.name: set_participant_id
methods.description: Sets the participant ID for session tracking.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, extracts messages, and invokes the Langchain chain.

methods.name: __get_token_value
methods.description: Extracts string value from message tokens or message chunks.

methods.name: _ainvoke
methods.description: Invokes the Langchain runnable with the provided text and streams the response.
